title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Compare Auckland gym prices and find the best gym membership for you in 2026
intro: Aucklanders have a wide range of gym options to choose from, with prices varying greatly depending on the suburb and amenities. With weekly prices starting from $15.95 at Jetts Gym in Auckland CBD, it's essential to compare prices and contract terms before signing up. From commuter gyms to 24/7 facilities, we've got you covered in our comprehensive guide.

sections.heading: Gym Options by Suburb
sections.body: Auckland is a large city with many suburbs, each with its own set of gym options. Some popular suburbs for gyms include Auckland CBD, Ponsonby, and Newmarket. In Auckland CBD, you can find gyms like Les Mills, Jetts Gym, and City Fitness, with prices ranging from $15.95 to $40 per week.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms
sections.body: For those who work in the city and want to fit in a gym session during their lunch break, there are several commuter gym options available. Jetts Gym and City Fitness both have locations in the Auckland CBD, with prices starting from $15.95 and $24.95 per week respectively.

sections.heading: CBD Gym Options
list: Jetts Gym: $15.95 per week, no contract
Les Mills: $29.95 per week, 12 month contract
City Fitness: $24.95 per week, 6 month contract
Anytime Fitness: $19.95 per week, 12 month contract

sections.heading: Parking and Amenities
sections.body: When choosing a gym, it's essential to consider the parking options and amenities available. Some gyms, like Les Mills, offer free parking for members, while others, like Jetts Gym, are located close to public transport links. Additionally, some gyms offer extra amenities like group fitness classes, personal training, and childcare services.
